notes.title: Important Update!
notes.notes:
SOUNDING
  - After several complaints about the game audios being too loud, I made volume adjustments on all of them, from start to finish, and also added an ambient sound so that in silent moments, the game would not be really muted, and deepen the game atmosphere.

LEVEL DESIGN AND INTERFACE
- Right at the beginning of the game, one of the instructions on the walls was not very clear to all players, and this has been changed to make it easier to understand. Another important aspect was the change of place of some obstacles in one of the phases that the players had more difficulties. Level Design now directs the player to the door they need to open, before giving them any items to carry. This way the player knows where he needs to go when he is carrying the first item.
OBS: Make no mistake, the phase is still difficult! It's just fairer

SMALL UPDATES
- While I was tinkering with the game, some small errors were fixed.

notes.title: Full screen!!!
notes.notes:
Finally the game has the option of full screen, just press F11 on the keyboard. And if your monitor is smaller than the game's default screen size, now you'll still be able to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247878/ff4c74890f6b6a208d796d2bd66b7980d14cd063.gif[/img]

notes.title: Two Problems Less
notes.notes:
The first problem concerns the moment when the player should touch an apple in a white tree, so that the apple would fall and be caught by a hand of shadows. This opens a passage. But when the error occurred, things happened like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247878/9a9208009642cedbec4a4e6b4166a9ea778b95f8.gif[/img]

Still, the passage opened. Which didn't impede the game's progress, but the aesthetics of the scene were all messed up. Even if that wasn't common, now it just doesn't happen anymore.


The second problem was very simple to solve and actually should never have passed me =/
In the final phase, the player shouldn't be able to leave the screen by any ledge at all (in any phase actually). But I had forgotten to close the boundaries in this last scene:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247878/968b4e43f9b5e6027cd4888d22a073caf172fd09.gif[/img]

Now that doesn't happen anymore.

Sorry for any inconvenience caused. And if you encounter any problems, don't hesitate to let me know by review in the store (I read them all) or by email: richardgamedesigner@gmail.com
